instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a:
David wants to plant some vegetables in his garden. He has plotted his garden on a grid, where each square has side lengths of 1 m.

What is the perimeter of his carrot patch?
atoms.sound: David wants to plant some vegetables in his garden. He has plotted his garden on a grid, where each square has side lengths of 1 metre. What is the perimeter of his carrot patch?

atoms.a: What is the perimeter of his tomato patch?
What is the perimeter of his broccoli patch?
What is the total perimeter of all three vegetable patches?

David wants to put up a small fence around each vegetable patch to keep out slugs.

If one metre of fence costs £30, how much will the entire cost be?

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a:
Harry is re-painting the outer lines of a football pitch. The whole pitch is 50 metres wide and 90 metres long.

If he paints one half of the pitch, including the halfway line, how many metres does he paint?

Harry now paints three extra lines to form the penalty area in the same half. The penalty area is 32 metres wide and 13.5 metres long.

How many more metres does he paint?
